api_checks.description: POST /api/applications as customer 4 with the AC payload; expect 201, id 1, DRAFT, applicant_user_id 4
GET /api/applications/1 and a VEHICLE and EDUCATION equivalent; assert required_documents lists, all MISSING
POST /api/applications PERSONAL tenure 72, then amount 10000.00; expect 422 TENURE_OUT_OF_RANGE / AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE
POST /api/applications with PAN 'abc', 11-digit Aadhaar -> 422 VALIDATION_ERROR; valid -> pan_masked ******234F, aadhaar_masked ********9012, no raw values
POST /api/policies base_version 1 PERSONAL.min_income 30000.00 as user 2; expect 201 v2 DRAFT, policy_v0002.json written, audit POLICY_CREATED, SHA-256 of policy_v0001.json unchanged
GET /api/products -> 200 while v2 is DRAFT; PERSONAL min_income 25000.00, policy_version 1
POST /api/policies/2/approve as ADMIN; expect 200 APPROVED, approved_by 1, audit POLICY_APPROVED, GET /api/products shows 30000.00 v2
PUT /api/policies/1 -> 405; PATCH and DELETE /api/policies/1 -> 405; raw SQL UPDATE of its thresholds aborts
POST /api/policies with auto_reject_below_score 750 > auto_approve_min_score 700, and min_income -1; expect 422 VALIDATION_ERROR naming field, no file written
